# The Vibe Candy Library

> Grimoires in plain text and ASCII art by Farmer Skot. Every piece is available as plain UTF-8 text.

## The Hermetic Codex

- [Manifest (JSON)](hermetic-codex/book.json)
- [I. The Emerald Tablet](hermetic-codex/text/01-the-emerald-tablet.txt): That which is above is like that which is below.
- [II. The Seven Hermetic Principles](hermetic-codex/text/02-the-seven-hermetic-principles.txt): Reality is a thought, and the thought keeps seven laws.
- [III. The Three Pillars of Wisdom](hermetic-codex/text/03-the-three-pillars-of-wisdom.txt): In three arts one wisdom stands: the work, the stars, the gods.
- [IV. The Great Work — Magnum Opus](hermetic-codex/text/04-the-great-work-magnum-opus.txt): Step into the black; the gold is on the far side of it.
- [V. The Caduceus — Staff of Hermes](hermetic-codex/text/05-the-caduceus-staff-of-hermes.txt): Marry the two serpents, and the staff grows wings.
- [VI. The Planes of Existence](hermetic-codex/text/06-the-planes-of-existence.txt): Every world is here; only your attention travels.
- [VII. Mental Transmutation](hermetic-codex/text/07-mental-transmutation.txt): Go by degrees: a mood is a string to be tuned, not an enemy.
- [VIII. The Divine Paradox](hermetic-codex/text/08-the-divine-paradox.txt): It is a dream, and it is the only one. Hold both.
- [IX. Invocation of Thoth](hermetic-codex/text/09-invocation-of-thoth.txt): Speak only what you would see written, and the Scribe answers.
- [X. The Corpus Hermeticum](hermetic-codex/text/10-the-corpus-hermeticum.txt): The one reading these words is what the words are about.
- [XI. Solve et Coagula](hermetic-codex/text/11-solve-et-coagula.txt): Unbind what has hardened; gather what has scattered; again.
- [XII. The Hermetic Seal](hermetic-codex/text/12-the-hermetic-seal.txt): Seal the vessel, keep the fire low, and open only to give.
